review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Verified p(30)=5604 and binom(5606,3)=29347802420 triple count
Checked local experiment tree (no S30 dump); noted HF archive dependence
Cross-checked max-g claims against analysis_n40.json / S40 finding cross-table
Compared timing strings (296.3s vs 7/7.4 min) across finding/experiment pages

claim_reviews.evidence: Unordered i≤j≤k count is binom(629,3)=41,278,754 (with p(20)=627 ⇒ 629 with conjugacy? standard p(20)=627; binom(627+2,3) depends on multiplicity convention). The stated 41,081,980 does not match the natural binom(629,3)=41,278,754.
claim_reviews.concerns: Clarify triple-indexing convention and regenerate the count.

claim_reviews.claim: S30 complete Kronecker table: 89.9% nonzero; max g = 5.18e16.
claim_reviews.evidence: analysis_n40.json and the S40 finding cross-table report max g(S30)=24,233,221,539,853 (~2.42e13), not 5.18e16. The same 5.18e16 figure is also used as max|χ| in places — a unit/meaning collision. Nonzero count vs HF archive byte size also disagrees at the ~22M-record level under a 14-byte record assumption.
claim_reviews.concerns: Highest-severity numeric conflict in the Kronecker program.

claim_reviews.claim: Runtime ~296.3s / "7 minutes" / "7.4 min" on the GPU cluster.
claim_reviews.evidence: Frontmatter 296.3s ≈4.9 min; titles say 7 or 7.4 min. Pick one archived log timing.

claim_reviews.claim: To our knowledge, largest complete Kronecker table publicly archived.
claim_reviews.evidence: Reasonable hedge if HF archive is intact; literature exhaustiveness is not repo-decidable. Local dump/checksum artifacts are missing.

missing_references: Local or HF checksum for the S30 dump; reconcile max-g with analysis_n40.json
Single canonical runtime from the production log
overall_assessment: A major computational archive almost certainly exists on Hugging Face, and the triple-count arithmetic for S30 is exact. But the public finding currently carries an internal contradiction on max g (5.18e16 vs 2.42e13) and inconsistent timings/paths. Silver remains plausible only after the max-g collision is resolved against primary artifacts.
recommendations: Reconcile max g across S30 finding, HF card, and analysis_n40.json — one number must win
Publish dump checksum and orthogonality validation log
certification_justification: Downgrade pending resolution of the max-g contradiction and missing local checksums. The computation may still deserve silver once numbers agree.
